spans.text: The DMS task permits the assessment of brain activation during the encoding, maintenance, and retrieval phases of working memory for smoking-related images and neutral images that serve as a control condition.

source_definition.value: Memory phase was defined as encoding during the sample period, maintenance during the delay period, and retrieval during the test period.

spans.text: Memory encoding activity was equated with the sample period while maintenance and retrieval activity were equated with the delay period and test period respectively.

model_settings.value: First-level general linear model with ten regressors convolved with a gamma hemodynamic response function; sample, delay, ITI, test-match, and test-non-match regressors for smoking and neutral conditions. Incorrect trials, six motion regressors, and data spikes were modeled as confounds. Results were combined across runs using second-level fixed effects and analyzed at the group level using a third-level mixed model. Cluster-based correction used Z = 2.3 and p < 0.05 across the entire brain.

caption.value: Brain reactivity to smoking vs. neutral images during delayed match to sample encoding, maintenance, and test periods. Brain area and Brodmann area refer to the location of each cluster of contiguous voxels. MNI coordinates (X, Y, Z) refer to the region of maximum cluster activation for each cluster.
